title: 5 useless facts you will never forget 🧠
description: Completely useless. Permanently stuck in your brain. Which one got you?

segments.text: Five facts that are completely useless, and you will remember them forever.
segments.label: Useless facts

segments.text: Number one. Wombats poop cubes. Actual little cubes.
segments.label: Fact #1

segments.text: Scientists think it stops the poop from rolling away, because wombats use it to mark their territory.
Number two. A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
segments.label: Fact #2

segments.text: It spins so slowly that one rotation takes two hundred and forty three Earth days, but one lap around the Sun only takes two hundred and twenty five.
Number three. Octopuses have three hearts.
segments.label: Fact #3

segments.text: Number four. Bananas are berries. Strawberries are not.
segments.label: Fact #4

segments.text: Botanists said so, and nobody stopped them.
Number five. The national animal of Scotland is the unicorn.
segments.label: Fact #5

segments.text: Which one broke your brain? Comment the number.
segments.label: Your turn
